capabilities: Manage saved PostgreSQL connections with host, port, credentials, and SSL settings
Execute SQL from fenced sql code blocks via a run button
Autocomplete tables, columns, and SQL keywords from the active database schema
Browse query results in a scrollable SQL results panel
Export query results as timestamped CSV files to Downloads
extras: Desktop-only (Windows, macOS, Linux); needs Obsidian 1.7.2+. README warns credentials are stored locally in plugin data and to install only if you trust the plugin with database credentials and network access. Manifest notes it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to connect to a database or run and view SQL query results without leaving the vault.
summary: PostgreSQL client that runs SQL from fenced code blocks in notes and displays results in a side panel, with saved connections and schema autocomplete.
